description: Random sandbox password: generate one sudo password for each Docker sandbox, remove the known default, and add agro secret get.

userStories.title: Generate one password for each Docker sandbox
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a random sudo password for each Docker sandbox so that nobody can use a published default.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/cli/src/lib/secrets.ts` exports `ensureSandboxPassword(root)`. If the entry `.env` has no `SANDBOX_PASSWORD` value, the function writes a value of 32 URL-safe base64 characters from `node:crypto` `randomBytes(24)`.
If `SANDBOX_PASSWORD` already has a value, `ensureSandboxPassword(root)` leaves the `.env` file byte-identical.
`runSandbox()` in `.agro/cli/src/commands/lifecycle.ts` calls `ensureSandboxPassword(root)` before it provisions a `docker` entry. The OpenShell path does not call the function.
`agro sandbox install docker --print-argv` writes no `.env` value.
Two new entries receive two different values.
`pnpm exec vitest run .agro/cli/src/lib/__tests__/secrets.test.ts .agro/cli/src/__tests__/lifecycle.test.ts .agro/cli/src/__tests__/sandbox.test.ts` exits 0.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Integrated on the task branch. Advisor re-ran: vitest secrets/lifecycle/sandbox exit 0 (207 tests); typecheck exit 0. C1-C5 executed by unit tests (32-char base64url from randomBytes(24); byte-identical when set; docker provision calls it, openshell path never reaches runSandbox; --print-argv writes nothing; two entries differ). Worker ran full suite exit 0 (2119 tests). Note: sandbox upgrade re-provisions through runSandbox, so an existing entry gains a password at upgrade; one upgrade test expectation updated. US-004 docs must state this.

userStories.title: Remove the known default
userStories.description: As an operator, I want no default password in the image and the Compose files. A sandbox without a configured password then has no usable password.
acceptanceCriteria: `.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml` and `.devcontainer/docker-compose.image-only.yml` pass `SANDBOX_PASSWORD=${SANDBOX_PASSWORD:-}`. `git grep -n test1234 -- .devcontainer .agro/cli/src .agro/scripts` prints nothing.
If `SANDBOX_PASSWORD` is set, `.devcontainer/entrypoint.sh` sets the `sandbox` password with `chpasswd`, as today.
If `SANDBOX_PASSWORD` is empty, `.devcontainer/entrypoint.sh` locks the `sandbox` password with `passwd -l sandbox` and prints one warning line that names `agro secret set SANDBOX_PASSWORD`.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/entrypoint.test.ts` asserts both branches and the order of the password step relative to the ownership repairs.
`pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/entrypoint.test.ts .agro/scripts/__tests__/sandbox-privilege-boundary.test.ts .agro/scripts/__tests__/compose-config-path-parity.test.ts` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Integrated. Advisor re-ran: vitest entrypoint/sandbox-privilege-boundary/compose-config-path-parity exit 0 (63 tests); `git grep -n test1234 -- .devcontainer .agro/cli/src .agro/scripts` prints nothing (exit 1); entrypoint holds `passwd -l sandbox`. Worker executed the image build and showed `passwd -S sandbox` reports L when empty and P when set; shellcheck -S warning clean.

userStories.title: Read the password back
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one command that prints the sandbox password. I use the password for `sudo` or SSH password auth without opening the secrets file.
acceptanceCriteria: `agro secret get <KEY> [--sandbox <name>]` prints the raw value of an allowed secret key and exits 0.
For a key without a value, `agro secret get` prints nothing to stdout, prints one line to stderr, and exits 1.
For a key outside `SECRET_KEYS`, `agro secret get` exits 1 with the existing `assertSecretKey()` message.
`agro secret list` keeps its redacted output.
`pnpm exec vitest run .agro/cli/src/__tests__/config-secret.test.ts` exits 0.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Integrated (6eca4324, a45089d3). Advisor re-ran: full vitest exit 0 (2130 tests); typecheck exit 0; SECRET_VERBS = [set, get, list] is the only verb list. C1-C4 executed by config-secret tests (raw value, missing value exits 1 with one stderr line, unknown key uses assertSecretKey, list stays redacted). Repair R1 removed a local verb type that duplicated SECRET_VERBS.

userStories.title: Update the documents
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the documents to describe the generated password so that no page tells me the old default.
acceptanceCriteria: `.example.env`, `docs/installation.md`, `docs/integrations/sshd.md`, `docs/security-considerations.md`, and `docs/configuration.md` name the generated password and `agro secret get SANDBOX_PASSWORD`, and contain no `test1234`.
`CHANGELOG.md` has one bullet under `## [Unreleased]` that names #1378.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh` reports no new finding on each changed document.
userStories.notes: Reopened by the advisor: docs/security-considerations.md does not name `agro secret get SANDBOX_PASSWORD` (grep -c returned 0). The other four docs and the changelog pass.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a live transcript so that the PR proves the password flow on a real sandbox. This story depends on US-001 through US-004.
acceptanceCriteria: The operator approves the use of a local or exe.dev Docker sandbox before the first live command.
`.agro/tasks/random-sandbox-password/evidence/manual-review.md` holds each command, its trimmed output, and its exit status, in the shape of `.agro/skills/git/references/manual-review.md`.
The transcript shows that `agro secret get SANDBOX_PASSWORD --sandbox <name>` prints a value of 32 characters. The transcript redacts the value.
The transcript shows that `sudo -S true` in the sandbox exits 0 with the generated value and exits non-zero with `test1234`.
The transcript ends with `agro destroy <name> --yes` and an `agro sandbox list` without the entry.
